title: The Three Widths of God
long_title: The Three Widths of God, The Three Widths of Love, The Three Widths of Being

teacher_notes:
The three "holies" point to the three withs of GOD, being (without, with, within)
like the prophet, this is our introduction to God.

There is also a peculiar connect to the centrality of the concept term GLORY. Each existential, ontological space in the withs has its "glory". It is essentially the "soul" of that cosm/space. The glory of an individual creation within the set of creation is the soul of that individual, and The spirit of GOD is GOD being the "soul" of that soul at the level of "WITHIN". That is the ultimate location in the inner experience of that individual creation. The creation also has an outer experience. This would be all other creations alongside this individual creation (including even the entire set of creation itself). The soul/apex of the entire apex of the set of creation enthrones The glory of creation, the glory that is GOD WITH US, God with creation in its outer / other / separate experiences. There is also a space/cosm that is BEYOND creation, or WITHOUT creation. This is the father. The son is the glory of WITH creation. The Father is the glory of the glory of creation, and is himself, only self and himself "outside of" / beyond / without creation. In this sense, created things / creations have all three ontological conceptual cosms. But GOD alone has no "WITHOUT" or "BEYOND" ontological cosm
scripture_list.text: And each one cried out to each other, saying this: HOLY, HOLY, HOLY, is Yahweh of Armies, The glory of HIM / His GLORY is filling / is-the-fullness of the seen realm (the earth)

versions.nirv: They were calling out to one another. They were saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord who rules over all. The whole earth is full of his glory.”
versions.leb: And the one called to the other and said, “Holy, holy, holy is Yahweh of hosts! The whole earth is full of his glory.”
versions.original: וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר קָדֹ֧ושׁ ׀ קָדֹ֧ושׁ ׀ קָדֹ֖ושׁ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאֹ֑ות מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבֹודֹֽו׃

versions.nirv: There is only one God and Father of everything. He is over everything. He acts through everything. He is in everything.
versions.leb: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
versions.original: εἷς θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ πάντων, ὁ ἐπὶ πάντων καὶ διὰ πάντων καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν.

versions.nirv: All things come from him. All things live by his power. All things honor him. Amen.
versions.leb: For from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory forever. Amen.
versions.original: ὅτι ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ δι' αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα· αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα εἰς τους αἰῶνας. ἀμήν.

versions.nirv: In the past, woman came from man. But now, man is born from woman. Everything comes from God.
versions.leb: For just as the woman is from the man, so also the man is through the woman, but all things are from God.
versions.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἡ γυνὴ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνδρός, οὕτως καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ διὰ τῆς γυναικός· τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ.

versions.nirv: All this is from God. He brought us back to himself through Christ. And he has given us the task of bringing others back to him.
versions.leb: And all things are from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and who gave us the ministry of reconciliation,
versions.original: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ καταλλάξαντος ἡμᾶς ἑαυτῷ διὰ Χριστοῦ καὶ δόντος ἡμῖν τὴν διακονίαν τῆς καταλλαγῆς,

versions.nirv: God created everything in heaven and on earth. He created everything that is seen and that is not seen. He created thrones, powers, rulers and authorities. Everything has been created through him and for him. He was alive before anything else was created. And he holds everything together.
versions.leb: because in him all things were created, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, the visible and the invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities—all things have been created through him and for him. And he is before all things, and all things hold together in him,
versions.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐκτίσθη τὰ πάντα ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὰ ὁρατὰ καὶ τὰ ἀόρατα, εἴτε θρόνοι εἴτε κυριότητες εἴτε ἀρχαὶ εἴτε ἐξουσίαι· τὰ πάντα δι' αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν ἔκτισται· καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν προ πάντων καὶ τὰ πάντα ἐν αὐτῷ συνέστηκεν,

versions.nirv: God is the one who made everything. All things exist for him. He wanted to bring many sons into glory. So he made the one who leads them to salvation perfect through suffering.
versions.leb: For it was fitting for him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to make perfect the pioneer of their salvation through sufferings.
versions.original: Ἔπρεπεν γὰρ αὐτῷ, δι' ὃν τὰ πάντα καὶ δι' οὗ τὰ πάντα, πολλοὺς υἱοὺς εἰς δόξαν ἀγαγόντα, τὸν ἀρχηγὸν τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν διὰ παθημάτων τελειῶσαι.

versions.nirv: Yet for us there is but one God. He is the Father. All things come from him. And we live for him. And there is but one Lord. He is Jesus Christ. All things came into being through him. And we live through him.
versions.leb: yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things and we for him, and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things and we through him.
versions.original: ἀλλ' ἡμῖν εἷς θεὸς ὁ πατήρ, ἐξ οὗ τὰ πάντα καὶ ἡμεῖς εἰς αὐτόν, καὶ εἷς κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστός, δι' οὗ τὰ πάντα καὶ ἡμεῖς δι' αὐτοῦ.

versions.nirv: The one who keeps God’s commands lives in him, and he lives in them. And this is how we know that he lives in us: We know it by the Spirit he gave us.
versions.leb: And the one who keeps his commandments resides in him and he in him. And by this we know that he resides in us: by the Spirit whom he has given to us.
versions.original: καὶ ὁ τηρῶν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν αὐτῷ. καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι μένει ἐν ἡμῖν, ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος οὗ ἡμῖν ἔδωκεν.

versions.nirv: No one has ever seen God. But if we love one another, God lives in us. His love is made complete in us. We know that we live in him and he lives in us. God has given us his Spirit. That is how we know. We have seen and we testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them and they live in God.
versions.leb: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God resides in us, and his love is perfected in us. By this we know that we reside in him and he in us, because he has given to us of his Spirit. And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son Savior of the world. Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God resides in him and he in God.
versions.original: Θεὸν οὐδεὶς πώποτε τεθέαται· ἐὰν ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὁ θεὸς ἐν ἡμῖν μένει καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν τετελειωμένη ἐστίν. ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ μένωμεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν ἡμῖν, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν. Καὶ ἡμεῖς τεθεάμεθα καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ ἀπέσταλκεν τὸν υἱὸν σωτῆρα τοῦ κόσμου. Ὃς ἂν ὁμολογήσῃ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ μένει καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν τῷ θεῷ.

versions.nirv: So you must go and make disciples of all nations. Baptize them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Teach them to obey everything I have commanded you. And you can be sure that I am always with you, to the very end of the age.
versions.leb: Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe everything that I have commanded you. And behold, I am with you all the days until the end of the age.
versions.original: πορευθέντες οὖν μαθητεύσατε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, βαπτίζοντες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος, διδάσκοντες αὐτοὺς τηρεῖν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰμι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἕως τῆς συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος.

versions.nirv: There are different kinds of gifts. But they are all given by the same Spirit. There are different kinds of service. But they are all given by the same Lord. There are different kinds of working. But they are all powered by the same God. He works all of them in everyone.
versions.leb: Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit; and there are varieties of ministries, and the same Lord; and there are varieties of results, but the same God, who works all things in all persons.
versions.original: Διαιρέσεις δὲ χαρισμάτων εἰσίν, τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα· καὶ διαιρέσεις διακονιῶν εἰσίν, καὶ ὁ αὐτὸς κύριος· καὶ διαιρέσεις ἐνεργημάτων εἰσίν, ὁ δὲ αὐτὸς θεός, ὁ ἐνεργῶν τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν.

versions.nirv: The Lord is the Spirit. And where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom. None of us has a veil over our faces. We can see the glory of the Lord. We reflect the Lord’s glory. We are being changed to be more like him. We have ever-increasing glory. And it comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
versions.leb: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, freedom. And we all, with unveiled face, reflecting the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
versions.original: ὁ δὲ κύριος τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν· οὗ δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα κυρίου, ἐλευθερία. ἡμεῖς δὲ πάντες ἀνακεκαλυμμένῳ προσώπῳ τὴν δόξαν κυρίου κατοπτριζόμενοι τὴν αὐτὴν εἰκόνα μεταμορφούμεθα ἀπὸ δόξης εἰς δόξαν, καθάπερ ἀπὸ κυρίου πνεύματος.

versions.nirv: We have turned away from secret and shameful ways. We do not use trickery. We do not twist God’s word. On the contrary, we set forth the truth clearly. In that way we show that we are pleasing to God in the sight of everyone. Even if our good news is covered with a veil, it is covered for those who are dying. The god of this age has blinded the minds of those who do not believe. They cannot see the light of the good news. The good news tells about the glory of Christ, who is the exact likeness of God. We do not preach about ourselves. We preach about Jesus Christ as Lord. We say that we are your servants for Jesus' sake. God said, "Let light shine out of darkness." He made his light shine in our hearts. He gave us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory. That glory shines in the face of Christ.
versions.leb: but we have renounced secret shameful things, not walking in cunning nor adulterating the word of God, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every conscience of people before God. But even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled among those who are perishing, in whom the god of this age has blinded the minds of the unbelievers, so that the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, would not shine on them. For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus' sake. For God, who said "Light shall shine out of darkness," is the one who shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Christ.
versions.original: ἀλλὰ ἀπειπάμεθα τὰ κρυπτὰ τῆς αἰσχύνης, μὴ περιπατοῦντες ἐν πανουργίᾳ μηδὲ δολοῦντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τῇ φανερώσει τῆς ἀληθείας συνιστάντες ἑαυτοὺς πρὸς πᾶσαν συνείδησιν ἀνθρώπων ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ. εἰ δὲ καὶ ἔστιν κεκαλυμμένον τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν, ἐν τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις ἐστὶν κεκαλυμμένον, ἐν οἷς ὁ θεὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἐτύφλωσεν τὰ νοήματα τῶν ἀπίστων εἰς τὸ μὴ αὐγάσαι τὸν φωτισμὸν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς δόξης τοῦ Χριστός, ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ θεοῦ. Οὐ γὰρ ἑαυτοὺς κηρύσσομεν ἀλλὰ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν κύριον, ἑαυτοὺς δὲ δούλους ὑμῶν διὰ Ἰησοῦν. ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ὁ εἰπὼν Ἐκ σκότους φῶς λάμψει, ὃς ἔλαμψεν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν πρὸς φωτισμὸν τῆς γνώσεως τῆς δόξης τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν προσώπῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

versions.nirv: The Lord who rules over all says, "A son honors his father. A servant honors his master. If I am a father, where is the honor I should receive? If I am a master, where is the respect I should be shown? Priests, you show disrespect for my name. But you ask, 'How have we shown disrespect for your name?'"
versions.leb: A son honors a father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is my fear? says Yahweh of hosts to you, O priests, who despise my name. But you say, "How have we despised your name?"
versions.original: בֵּן יְכַבֵּד אָב וְעֶבֶד אֲדֹנָיו וְאִם־אָב אָנִי אַיֵּה כְבֹודִי וְאִם־אֲדֹנִים אָנִי אַיֵּה מֹורָאִי אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאֹות לֲכֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים בּוֹזֵי שְׁמִי וַאֲמַרְתֶּם בַּמֶּה בָזִינוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ׃

versions.nirv: Finally, brothers and sisters, rejoice! Strive for full restoration, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you. Greet one another with a holy kiss. All God’s people here send their greetings. May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
versions.leb: Finally, brothers, rejoice, be restored, be encouraged, agree with one another, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you. Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the saints greet you. The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
versions.original: Λοιπόν, ἀδελφοί, χαίρετε, καταρτίζεσθε, παρακαλεῖσθε, τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖτε, εἰρηνεύετε, καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθ' ὑμῶν. Ἀσπάσασhe ἀλλήλους ἐν ἁγίῳ φιλήματι. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἅγιοι πάντες. Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἡ κοινωνία τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.

base_body:
## drafting the outline chain
1. BEING - I WILL BE WHO I WILL BE ; I AM THAT I AM (Being himself is a person (BEING THE PERSON) (himself))
1.1 Mind Movie > I will be who I will be. I am. step into the light as I am. Step into the light as I am in the light. See in me.
1.2 Concept_term: BEING, is-ness, am-ness < The BE-er BE-s the BEing > a person
1.3 concept_term: SELF, I, me ;
1.4 concept_term: OTHER, not-me-beings ; he alone is being himself, before all others: he alone and only is being himself, and NO OTHER
1.5 concept_term: NESTED BEING, nested ontology, < where does "me" end and the "other" begin? How do I map me-ness? introduce Russian doll nested parable. how do I map
1.6. Start the map with two types of Beings: CREATOR & CREATION
1.6. The starting place = this ultimate and first "I", this only and alone "I am" and self, himself BEING, the person. He is the creator. concept_term: creator.
1.7 All other beings, shares in this being, this person, are after. The many beings are together, apart of the other being CREATION
1.8. Mapping the "be-ing", is-ness of of creations is basically 3-fold: the three WITHS.
1.9. WITHIN all beings having a share in "be-ing", are
2.10 WITH
2,11 WITHOUT
• step into being himself ; the core of being is a person, BEING himself. :: all beings having a share in "be-ing", thus share being with this person.
• the SELF. the I am
• the other, the not-me beings
• the current state: others exist.
• nested being ; mapping me-ness vs others
• start at the beginning of being. start before the beginning of being
• There is no beginning to being himself. He alone is being himself
2. WITHOUT - GOD HIMSELF, HIMSELF LOVE, BEING HIMSELF: WITHOUT CREATION, BY HIMSELF ALONE, THE ONLY ONE BEING
3. WITH - GOD HIMSELF, HIMSELF LOVE, BEING HIMSELF: WITH OTHER BEINGS WITH CREATION, ALONGSIDE THE MANY, TOGETHER OUTSIDE
4. WITHIN ~ GOD, HIMSELF, HIMSELF LOVE, BEING HIMSELF: WITHIN CREATION, WITHIN OTHER BEINGS, IN THE MANY, TOGETHER INSIDE
